description: This file contains implementation of backend APIs for the COSA Data Model Library, specifically for the MsgBusTestServer component. It provides functions to set and get parameters (string and integer types) related to message bus testing, along with relevant includes and licensing info.

methods.name: BOOL MsgBusTest_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * strValue)
methods.description: Sets the value of the global ParamString if the parameter name matches 'ParamString'.

methods.name: ULONG MsgBusTest_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of ParamString if the parameter name matches 'ParamString'.

methods.name: BOOL MsgBusTest_SetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int value)
methods.description: Sets the value of the global ParamInt if the parameter name matches 'ParamInteger'.

methods.name: BOOL MsgBusTest_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of ParamInt if the parameter name matches 'ParamInteger'.

ctags.name: MsgBusTest_GetParamIntValue
ctags.pattern: /^BOOL MsgBusTest_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext, char* ParamName, int* pInt)$/

ctags.name: MsgBusTest_SetParamIntValue
ctags.pattern: /^BOOL MsgBusTest_SetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext, char* ParamName, int value)$/
